caption: The drawing features two representations of the same botanical motif side by side on a light beige background. On the right, there is a colored rendering of an irregularly shaped brown object, possibly a fragment of pottery or stone, with a carved design. The design on this fragment consists of a stylized, curving stem with leaf shapes and three clusters of small, oval shapes that resemble wheat or grain heads, colored in darker brown and outlined in a thin reddish-brown line for contrast. The carved stem has a series of repeating, semicircular notches along one side, forming an undulating pattern that follows the curve. On the left, there is a line drawing in black that mirrors the carved design on the brown fragment, depicting the same curving stem, notched pattern, leaves, and clusters of oval shapes but without any color fill or shading. The artist's name, "Frank N. Orsay," is written in small, neat letters at the bottom right of the image.
title: Calico Printing Blocks
